zh-CN.title: 个人作品集
zh-CN.goal: 围绕作品与过程建立清楚、可信的个人展示。

optionalInputs.question: 面向招聘、客户还是个人记录？
有哪些作品、图片和链接可以展示？
每个作品中自己的角色与贡献是什么？
有没有喜欢的视觉方向与联系渠道？

qualityChecks: 让真实作品成为视觉主角，按叙事组织而非填满统一卡片。
项目筛选、放大与外链要可用；没有作品图时优先排版与过程说明。
不伪造客户评价、雇主、奖项或成果；联系表单展示不等于已经接通采集。
zh-CN.missingInformationPolicy: 所有问题均可跳过；使用已有资料，显式列出影响结果的假设，未知事实保留待确认。

en.title: Portfolio
en.goal: Present selected work and process with a clear and credible personal narrative.

optionalInputs.question: Is this for recruiters, clients or a personal archive?
Which projects, images and links can be shown?
What was your role and contribution in each project?
Do you have a visual preference and a contact method to include?

qualityChecks: Let real work lead the design and organize it through a narrative.
Make filters, image views and links work; use process and typography when images are unavailable.
Do not invent clients, employers, awards or testimonials; a contact form is not automatically connected.
en.missingInformationPolicy: All questions may be skipped. Use known material, state consequential assumptions, and leave unknown facts unresolved.
